output.message: My earlier message does not apply to the current numbers. As Members_07 and _05 noted, Pine’s post is incorrect: 25 ÷ 5 = 5 packs per team, not 8, so I downvoted post 11. Maple’s 15 ÷ 3 = 5 and Hazel’s 36 ÷ 9 = 4 are correct, so I upvoted posts 12 and 13. Pine, please correct the allocation to 5 packs per team.
